description: List the stored QA issues of a branch, one page at a time, with the counts per severity. Filter by severity, key, language or source (rule = the built-in checks, ai = AI review findings). Pass nextCursor back as `cursor` for the next page. Reads the token's base branch unless `branch` names another allowed branch.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

lang.description: Only issues in this target language.

source.description: rule = QA checks, ai = AI review findings.

name: get_qa_issues
title: Get QA Issues
